item.title: Indenture
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: PUSH! Publication
  • 発売日: 2024-06-29
  • スコア: 5.59/10 (9 人評価)
  • 日本語名: Indenture
  • 英語名: 无

あらすじ

The Nishimura family resides in the quiet countryside far away from the city in Japan. A proud family with a history of Kendo and owns a Kendo Dojo, their name was famous and influential. That is of course until one day, tragedy struck their family. A haunting secret deal that was made by the family years ago has come to haunt them. How would the Nishimura family deal with this? Would it be the end of them or is there a way to save their reputation and their beloved Dojo?

あらすじ

Tanaka Ryuu is your typical salaryman who worked as an accountant in a company. He lives a boring life full of work every day until one day he went drinking with his colleagues at Shinjuku after work. As he heads home, a nice girl in a bunny outfit introduced to him “Usagi Health Club” a health club for people like him. Reluctantly, he decided to give it a try.

あらすじ

Ishihara Kasumi’s a Japanese student attending as a freshman at an Australian college. She’s wanted to study in this college ever since she heard that her favorite swimmer, Zoe Kaplan, is also studying there. Dying to join the swimming club, she manages to pass the selection test and can’t wait to train with her idol. However, Kasumi soon finds out that all that glitters is not gold.
